video_generation_prompt: Ultra-premium CGI commercial for Nestlé NAN COMFOR Família Comfor. Five-second static composition where nourishment becomes innovation. Locked frontal camera, 70mm equivalent. Seamless first-to-last frame interpolation starting exactly as FRAME-1 and ending exactly as FRAME-2. STRICT BRAND PRESERVATION: preserve exact NAN COMFOR package geometry, proportions, scale, label placement, typography, magenta-to-purple gradient background, and the exact reference bird from packaging artwork: flat white silhouette body, deep magenta-burgundy outline contour lines, long pointed sharp beak, stylized curved head crest, rounded compact chest, broad angular wings with deep magenta edging, elegant tail at every frame. VISUAL IDENTITY: poetic and graceful — all motion is slow_and_deliberate, organic, luminous. TIMELINE: 0.00-0.55s: faint magenta circuits and molecular constellations awaken at the edges, slowly breathing with light. 0.55-1.20s: natural white milk rises from below like a luminous ribbon and turns into a graceful vortex, carrying glowing vitamin particles, probiotic forms and nucleotide symbols within its flow. 1.20-2.90s: three NAN COMFOR cans are revealed one after another from the heart of the vortex — left, right, then the larger central can — each lifted by a separate wave before settling into exact final arrangement. 2.90-3.60s: exact reference bird emerges from behind the camera with its white-and-magenta graphic identity — one angular wing passes extremely close to the lens like a soft visual wipe, then the bird glides forward and lands inside the central can. 3.60-4.25s: milk spiral becomes calmer, forming subtle protective ring as side cans drift slightly apart and scientific elements continue floating. 4.25-5.00s: luminous particles gather into the final seal which appears as a precise radiant emblem surrounded by a delicate golden-magenta glow, resolving exactly into FRAME-2. No subtitles. No text overlay.
negative_prompt: deformed packaging, incorrect proportions, label distortion, illegible text, brand replacement, logo alteration, unauthorized color shift, additional products, extra objects, people, hands, utensils, subtitles, watermarks, camera cuts within clip, background replacement, physics glitches, identity drift, hallucinated graphics, hallucinated text, motion blur obscuring labels, excessive bloom, lens dirt, chromatic aberration, incorrect bird design, bird color changes, package intersection, floating packages after settling, particle explosion
camera: Locked frontal, 70mm. No movement. Poetic, slow, breathing feel. Wing passes extremely close to lens at 2.90-3.05s as soft visual wipe.
lighting: Soft, luminous, poetic. Faint circuit breathing at edges. Milk luminous ribbon. Golden-magenta glow on final seal. Low-intensity everything — contrast comes from luminosity not harshness.
motion: slow breathing circuits, luminous milk ribbon vortex, wave-lifted sequential can reveals (1.20-2.90s is longer — more gradual waves), bird wing wipe soft, landing, milk protective ring, seal radiant emblem
